stack: Go (standard library time/testing only) — no new runtime dependencies. Change confined to the in-process alert engine's sustainedWindow logic and a new white-box unit/integration test file. Existing CI (.github/workflows/security-gate.yml) already runs `go test ./...` on push to main, satisfying NFR-010 without a new workflow.

technical_debt.substitution: Implementation keeps a 2-entry bounded `samples` slice (run-start + latest) instead of the scalar firstAt/lastAt fields proposed in 02_SYSTEM_DESIGN.md ADR-002.
technical_debt.reason: The existing regression test TC-NA-076f inspects `w.samples` directly (require.Len(w.samples, 1)); removing the field would break its compilation, violating the regression boundary. The 2-entry cap still delivers O(1) memory (FR-017) and span-based confirmation (FR-016) — verified by TC-SAW-017e (len(samples) <= 2 after a 100x-duration breach) and TC-SAW-017h (0 allocations per add).
technical_debt.effort_to_fix: low — could migrate to scalar fields and update TC-NA-076f if the slice field is ever removed; no functional benefit, so deliberately not done.
